collections.name: Coastal Mornings
collections.description: Soft sea blues and washed light — the palette of an early walk along the shore.
collections.story: Built from the cool, low-chroma blues of sea mist at sunrise, when the horizon and the water share the same pale light.

collections.name: Forest Bathing
collections.description: The green quiet of standing among trees — mossy, leafy, restorative.
collections.story: A study in greens at different depths of canopy, from sunlit leaf to the dark cool of the understory.

collections.name: Desert Light
collections.description: Sun-warmed clay, sand and ochre — the colours of arid afternoon.
collections.story: Warm earth tones spaced through the ambers and terracottas of baked ground and low desert sun.

collections.name: Nordic Winter
collections.description: Pale, cold and spare — the restrained light of a northern winter.
collections.story: Very low chroma blues and neutrals, perceptually spaced so the palette stays calm and almost monochrome.

collections.name: Golden Hour
collections.description: The warm, glowing light of the last hour before sunset.
collections.story: Sunset warmth — peaches, marigolds and rose-golds — with the occasional cool note the low sun leaves behind.

collections.name: Botanical
collections.description: Fresh greens and clean floral accents — a hothouse in colour.
collections.story: Lively greens paired with bright florals, kept fresh and a little playful for product and retail surfaces.

collections.name: Concrete & Moss
collections.description: Soft brutalism — poured grey softened by living green.
collections.story: Near-neutral greys at very low chroma, lifted by a single moss-green so the set reads architectural, not cold.

collections.name: Tide & Sand
collections.description: Where ocean meets shore — cool water against warm sand.
collections.story: A deliberate complementary tension: clear ocean blues set against warm, sunlit sand.

collections.name: Jewel Box
collections.description: Saturated, precious tones — emerald, sapphire, amethyst, ruby.
collections.story: High-chroma gem hues, perceptually spaced and AA-checked so they stay rich without becoming garish.

collections.name: Orchard
collections.description: Ripe fruit colours — plum, apricot, berry and cider.
collections.story: Warm, slightly retro fruit tones spanning the reds, plums and golds of a late-season orchard.

collections.name: Studio Mono
collections.description: Near-monochrome systems — grayscale with the quietest cast.
collections.story: Almost-neutral ramps for interface-first work, each carrying a barely perceptible hue so the greys feel intentional.

collections.name: Meadow Dusk
collections.description: Lavender, heather and iris at the soft end of day.
collections.story: Dreamy violets and mauves spaced gently in OKLCH, for a calm, slightly romantic surface.
